items.q: What if our steam fails EN 285 at the sterilizer?
items.a: Usually the header, not the generator, is wet. We size both, so it is ours to find: we test, correct the header and retest. [header retest included or quoted separately]

items.q: Does the condensate really have to meet WFI?
items.a: For steam that sterilizes materials or product-contact surfaces, yes (Annex 1, 6.17), without microbial testing. Steam that only heats jackets or coils can be plant steam.

items.q: EN 285 is European. Does it apply to us?
items.a: Annex 1, applied by Health Canada as GUI-0119, names the tests but sets no numbers. Most sites use EN 285; if your sterilizer maker is stricter, we design to that.

items.q: How often do we have to test?
items.a: Annex 1 sets no interval. Common: condensate and gases quarterly, dryness annually, superheat watched continuously. Your validation plan sets the frequency.
